description: Verify that DUT immediately ceases its claim and re-probes after a SINGLE ARP Reply conflict on its committed Link-Local address (RFC 3927 §2.5, MAY)
approach:
[Objective]
_06..09 cover two-conflict CEASE behaviour. _10 hits the RFC 3927 §2.5 MAY-immediate-cease branch: a single conflict is enough to abandon the LL. DUT's always-cease implementation reaches the re-pick verdict identically — only one Reply is injected, but the abandonment must still trigger.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → 1st Announce → post_claim entry observer fires:
   • UT-query DUT_LL → snapshot
   • Tester → DUT: 1 ARP Reply with sender_proto_ip = committed LL

3. Observation (re-probe window):
   • DUT → wire: a fresh ARP Probe with target_proto_ip ≠ snapshotted committed LL   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Claim observed AND a fresh Probe with a different LL after the single conflict.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_claim_observed — DUT did not announce its committed LL
• Fail_no_reprobe — DUT did not re-probe after the single conflict ARP

verdicts.Pass: DUT ceased and re-probed after a single ARP Reply conflict — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_claim_observed: DUT did not announce its committed Link-Local address
verdicts.Fail_no_reprobe: DUT did not re-probe after the single conflict ARP
